title: Chicken Piccata
description: Lightly floured chicken cutlets pan seared and simmered in a generous lemon, caper and garlic butter sauce.

steps.title: Cut cutlets
steps.text: Slice {chicken} into thinner cutlets with the KitchenAid tenderizer or by butterflying.

steps.title: Dredge
steps.text: Lightly dredge the cutlets in {flour} and shake off the excess.

steps.title: Heat pan
steps.text: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat with {oil} and {searbutter}.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Cook the chicken for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Start sauce
steps.text: Reduce the heat to medium. Melt {saucebutter} and cook {garlic} for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Simmer sauce
steps.text: Add {broth}, the juice of {lemons} and {capers}. Simmer for 5 to 8 minutes until slightly reduced.
Taste and adjust the salt if needed.

steps.title: Finish chicken
steps.text: Return the chicken to the sauce and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the sauce over the chicken and garnish with {parsley}.

notes: Target plating time 5:30 PM: cutlets at 5:00, sear at 5:05, sauce at 5:15, chicken back in at 5:22. Do not be shy with the sauce; serve with Cream Cheese Yukon Potatoes to catch every drop and APO Roasted Broccoli on the side. Still in development: the sauce is thin as written, so next time consider a small cornstarch slurry to make it cling.
